service.description: Retrieves an active Meta-JSON layout buffer for a given artifact path. If no buffer exists, or if a corrupted error state is cached, it forces a fresh compilation pass.

service-call.name: create#org.moqui.ai.WorkspaceBuffer
service-call.in-map: [ artifactUri: artifactUri, userId: userId ?: ec.user.userId ?: 'system_ide_user', metaJsonBuffer: rawJsonText, lastUpdatedStamp: ec.user.nowTimestamp ]

service.description: Updates the stateful layout tree buffer string. Because enable-audit-log is active on the underlying entity, this automatically triggers a version checkpoint.
